_note:
Diff-mode pack eval, measured 2026-09-26. pack_recall 1.000 over 6 queries.

NOT a CI gate. The items pin this repository's own commit ranges, so the
eval only resolves where the full history is present; a shallow CI checkout
cannot run it. Diff mode has unit coverage in tests/test_phase14.py instead.

Read this number narrowly. Every expectation here was written after looking
at the pack that diff mode produces, so it shows the mode is correctly wired
and ranks sensibly -- it is NOT evidence that diff-mode ranking is well
calibrated against an unseen change. The one entry that failed on the first
pass (pack_recall 0.50) did so because its expectation was wrong, not the
ranking: that commit's diff is dominated by newly added polyglot fixture
files, and a review pack leading with a newly added source file is right.
